name: Thesis-driven essay grading assistant

categories.label: Thesis/Content
categories.description: Original, defensible thesis with sustained critical thinking and meaningful deductions.

categories.label: Organization/Structure
categories.description: Purposeful structure with strong progression, clear transitions, and a conclusion that extends thinking.

categories.label: Evidence/Support
categories.description: Precise, well-integrated evidence that deepens analysis and builds authority.

categories.label: Voice/Style
categories.description: Authentic voice with engaging, precise language and consistent tone.

categories.label: Grammar/Syntax/Formatting
categories.description: Technical correctness and polished presentation that support clarity.

calibrationNotes: Represents the pre-existing Yawp thesis-driven essay grading assistant path.

name: ACT Writing four-domain grading assistant

categories.label: Ideas and Analysis
categories.description: Evaluate the clarity of the writer's perspective and analysis of the relationships among perspectives.

categories.label: Development and Support
categories.description: Evaluate how well claims are developed with reasoning, examples, and implications.

categories.label: Organization
categories.description: Evaluate purposeful sequencing, paragraphing, transitions, and control of the response.

categories.label: Language Use and Conventions
categories.description: Evaluate word choice, sentence control, grammar, usage, and mechanics as they affect clarity.

promptConfigJson.scoreInstructions: Scores must be integers 1-6 for each ACT domain. The app converts the average domain score to a 2-12 ACT-style composite for display.
promptConfigJson.rubricInstructions: Score the four ACT Writing domains independently. Focus first on Ideas and Analysis and Development and Support. Language Use and Conventions matters when errors impede clarity.
promptConfigJson.systemInstructions: Grade this as ACT Writing with four rubric domains. Do not use thesis-driven essay categories. Give concise retrospective feedback for each ACT domain.

calibrationNotes: Pilot ACT template. Canonical ACT rubric source and calibration set still need Brian/Kevin sign-off before recorded-grade rollout.
